description: This file defines types, functions, and a flow for customer authentication, including session management, login, registration, and token normalization, with support for backend API integration or fallback to local UI-only auth.

methods.name: nowIso
methods.description: Returns current date-time in ISO string format.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to string if it is a string, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-array object.

methods.name: safeParseJson
methods.description: Safely parses JSON string into an object, returns null on failure.

methods.name: normalizeBearerToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token into 'Bearer ...' format if not already.

methods.name: getCustomerAuthStorageKey
methods.description: Returns the localStorage key used for customer auth session.

methods.name: loadPersistedCustomerAuthSession
methods.description: Loads and validates persisted customer auth session from localStorage.

methods.name: saveCustomerAuthSession
methods.description: Persists customer auth session to localStorage.

methods.name: clearCustomerAuthSession
methods.description: Removes persisted customer auth session from localStorage.

methods.name: getDevBearerTokenFromEnv
methods.description: Reads optional dev JWT token from environment variables.

methods.name: buildLocalAuthenticatedSession
methods.description: Creates a local-only authenticated session object.

methods.name: createCustomerAuthFlow
methods.description: Creates a customer authentication flow with login, register, and logout methods, supporting backend API or fallback to local auth.
